entity.summary: Non-custodial Cardano wallet ecosystem distributed through web, browser-extension and mobile surfaces.
entity.notes: Current Eternl first-party wiki states encrypted private keys remain on the user's computer or hardware wallet and never on Eternl servers. Initial launch date remains unresolved in this breadth pass.

products.summary: Eternl non-custodial Cardano browser-extension wallet for DApp integration and wallet management.
products.notes: Selected browser-extension runtime only; web/PWA and mobile surfaces are deferred.

events.title: Eternl v2.1.5.0 released
events.description: Eternl published v2.1.5.0 with a Ledger signing hotfix and marked the Eternl browser extension as available, documenting active extension maintenance in July 2026.

events.title: Eternl v2.0.5 introduced the Eternl v2 interface
events.description: Eternl released v2.0.5 on 2025-04-08 as the Eternl v2 milestone with an all-new UI, 30+ languages, MonsterSwap, portfolio overview, multi-signature wallet support, enhanced Ada Handle functionality, and OneKey hardware-wallet support.

evidence.title: About Eternl
evidence.notes: Current first-party wiki states Eternl stores encrypted private keys only on the user's computer or hardware wallet, never on Eternl servers.

evidence.title: Eternl Supported Platforms
evidence.notes: First-party Eternl platform page separates web/PWA, browser extension and mobile and states all versions are fully non-custodial.

evidence.title: Eternl updates / release notes — v2.1.5.0
evidence.notes: First-party release notes list v2.1.5.0 as released 2026-07-10 and mark Eternl Extension available.

evidence.title: What's New in v2?
evidence.notes: First-party Eternl v2 documentation describes the v2 UI, 30+ languages, MonsterSwap, portfolio, multi-sig support, governance, and new dApp browser.
